name: Plug-in
description: Configure and build the formats in config.cmake (VST3, Standalone; AU on the Mac)

name: Sign plug-in
description: Windows: Azure Trusted Signing of the .vst3 and .exe. Mac: Developer ID codesign of the VST3, AU and app (the app with the audio-input entitlement). SKIP without credentials.
github_note: On Windows the workflow keeps the pinned azure/trusted-signing-action for this call; the Mac step runs the script.

name: Installer
description: Windows: Inno Setup installer. Mac: component packages and the distribution package, each signed with Developer ID Installer when that identity is available.

name: Sign or notarize installer
description: Windows: Azure Trusted Signing of the installer. Mac: notarize and staple the distribution package. SKIP without credentials.
github_note: On Windows the workflow keeps the pinned azure/trusted-signing-action for this call; the Mac step runs the script.

name: Verify installer
description: The final installer and every binary inside it are signed (Mac: notarized and stapled, hardened runtime, the app's entitlement); writes <installer>.sha256. SKIP for an unsigned desk build.

name: Web demo
description: Wonderlab/Emscripten build of the web demo into build/web (BinaryData, WebAssembly, assembled page)

name: Web staging preview
description: Bundle build/web with its commit and checksums, and deploy it to the private, noindex web-staging preview only. Never a live demo.
